rca of the issue: Root cause: Home.jsx was not touched in this fix round. The FIX 2 update focused on DigitalTransformation.jsx (replaced hero video with DarkHero component using bg-brand-ink). Home.jsx retained its original video-backed hero (<video data-testid="hero-bg-video" src="/media/hero-bg.webm">) plus two decorative section videos (method-bg-video, cta-band-video). Reproduction: navigate to https://dt-nav-update.preview.emergentagent.com/ , inspect DOM — document.querySelectorAll('video').length === 3. Mitigation: In /app/frontend/src/pages/Home.jsx, remove the <video> element from the hero section and any decorative <video> elements, replacing with a static on-theme background (image + gradient overlay or pure CSS treatment) mirroring the DT DarkHero pattern.
